description: Live cases for failures that were found in real runs (see docs/regressions.md).  Each one spans the model, so the unit test alone does not prove it.  Expected outputs were written before any run.  First live run 2026-10-14:  every case matched the expected kind.  Claude read the notes once; two people still need to grade them (PRD 3d).

cases.label: A hyphenated time is read as minutes
cases.input: Give me a 20-minute workout with dumbbells.  Chest.

expect.notes: A plan, with no question about time.  Calculated total between 15 and 25 minutes.  A failing score is a clarifying question or an error.

cases.label: Exercise names that contain parentheses are accepted
cases.input: I have 20 minutes and a mat.  Core.

expect.notes: A plan in which every exercise name carries '(Floor)' exactly as returned.  A failing score is the visible error caused by names the checks could not read.

cases.notes_setup: The runner appends ' (Floor)' to every English exercise name on the raw page, because a live page does not always contain a name with parentheses.
